faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. It will be held in Cebu City, Philippines. This date marks the Cebu leg of the broader National MILO Marathon series organized by RUNRIO Inc. for that year.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers five distance categories: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half marathon is listed as the primary distance for this race, giving participants a range of options depending on their fitness level and experience.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this event?

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg is organized by RUNRIO Inc., the group behind the long-running MILO Marathon event series in the Philippines. This Cebu leg is part of the broader national marathon program held across multiple cities.
